title: Mini Glazing Mist Hydrating Face Spray
descriptionHtml:
✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Good for: Skin Barrier✓ Gluten Free✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Clean at Sephora
What it is: A superfine, high-performance mist that hydrates and refreshes for a next-level glowy finish.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness and Dullness

Formulation: Spray

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Ectoin: Binds water molecules to the skin to keep it hydrated.
- Ceramide Trio (NP, AP, EOP): Moisturizes, smooths, and reinforces the skin’s natural barrier.
- Magnolia Extract: Antioxidant containing magnolol and honokiol that purifies and soothes skin.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Glazing Mist lets you take the benefits of your rhode routine on the go. It instantly leaves sk
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Glazing Mist is multipurpose so you can use it in many ways. Don’t forget to shake before use!
-Apply it in your skincare routine as the first step after cleansing and the last step after moisturizer.
-Use it under makeup as hydrating skin prep or on top of makeup for moisture and glow.
-Take it on the go and mist onto face whenever skin needs a refresh.
Ingredients+
-Ectoin: Binds water molecules to the skin to keep it hydrated.
-Ceramide Trio (NP, AP, EOP): Moisturizes, smooths, and reinforces the skin’s natural barrier.
-Magnolia Extract: Antioxidant containing magnolol and honokiol that purifies and soothes skin.

Water/Aqua/Eau, Isononyl Isononanoate, Polyglyceryl-10 Oleate, Propanediol, Glycerin, Panthenol, Ectoin, Beta-Glucan, Ceramide Np, Ceramide Ap, Ceramide Eop, Magnolia Officinalis Bark Extract, Xanthan Gum, Phytosphingosine, Caprylyl Glycol, Cholesterol, Carbomer, Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Citric Acid.

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
